subject: Activation stitch: proposed Activation Pact and kickoff
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@lumoshealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Activation stitch: proposed Activation Pact and kickoff

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Per our conversation I put together a lightweight "Activation Pact" (attached) that sequences the core onboarding milestones so both teams have clear owners, target dates, and acceptance criteria. High level below — the attached spreadsheet has the dependency lanes and an initial resource roster.

Core milestones (proposed):
- Kickoff & discovery (Nov 9): 2-hour working session to confirm data schema and success metrics — Owner: Jordan Blake (Redwood) / Sarah Patel (Lumos)
- Data mapping & ingestion (Nov 10–Nov 23): Red team provides sample dataset; Lumos to confirm column-level transformations — Owner: Ben Carter (Redwood) / Lumos Data Team
- Security review & evidence handoff (Nov 12–Nov 18): provide SOC 2 artifacts, KMS info, and retention policy — Owner: Monica Patel (Redwood) / Procurement (Lumos)
- Test generation / smoke validation (Nov 24–Nov 30): run 3 smoke test passes, fix critical defects — Owner: Ben Carter (Redwood)
- Pilot cutover (Dec 6): final acceptance and go/no-go decision — Owner: Jordan Blake (Redwood) / Sarah Patel (Lumos)

Ask: please confirm (1) whether Nov 9 kickoff works for your team, (2) main contact for security artifacts, and (3) any blackout windows we should avoid during Nov–Dec.

Attachment: activation_pact_v1.xlsx (compact milestone sheet; tabs: timeline, owners, dependencies)

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0133

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Activation stitch: proposed Activation Pact and kickoff

Jordan — quick internal note before we lock dates with Lumos.

A few points:
- Data mapping: we should reserve an engineer (Samir) for the Nov 10–23 window; he can own the ingestion scripts and the sample pipeline.
- Security: confirm whether Lumos uses BYOK/KMS or needs our managed key workflow; if BYOK we'll need a short integration step and a vendor review.
- SOW items: I'll drop a SOW-draft-20261101.docx in the Drive; it includes acceptance criteria per milestone and a brief escalation path.

Risk flags: the pilot cutover date (Dec 6) assumes no major schema churn from Lumos. If they have an ongoing ETL schedule, we should build an alternate freeze window.

I'll be on the kickoff if dates hold.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@lumoshealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Lumos Health Procurement <procurement@lumoshealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T10:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Activation stitch: proposed Activation Pact and kickoff

Jordan — thanks for the clear plan and the attachment. Nov 9 for kickoff works for the Ops and Product leads (we'll do 9–11am PT). A couple of items from our side:

- Security artifacts: procurement will attach a short questionnaire (I've cc'd procurement). They'll also need SOC 2 Type II scanning evidence and our security team will want a brief architecture diagram showing how data moves between our systems and Redwood.
- KMS: we use an HSM-backed KMS via our cloud provider and prefer BYOK for customer data; I'll confirm the KMS contact by EOD.
- Blackout windows: Lumos has a quarterly release on Nov 18–19; please avoid major deploys those dates.

I've attached the Lumos_Security_Questionnaire.pdf with the fields we'll ask you to complete ahead of the kickoff. We'll upload the completed procurement packet after your responses.

Thanks — confirm the Nov 9 kickoff invite and we can finalize attendees.

—Sarah
Sarah Patel
Director, Operations | Lumos Health
sarah.patel@lumoshealth.com
Attachment: Lumos_Security_Questionnaire.pdf
